primary_general_outcome: mean successful placements per held-out challenge
line_efficiency_status: observable secondary measure; under-resolved and excluded from primary diagnosis
calibration: reuse exact committed Hour 5 calibration parameters from artifacts/hour5/demo/calibration_parameters.json
mixed_rule: If top-two margin is below 0.35, use the primary diagnosis tutorial while retaining low/mixed and mixed=true; include in all analyses and describe by confidence where sample sizes permit.
target_skill_outcome: held-out post score minus held-out pre score for the diagnosed skill; higher is better
overall_target_standardization: divide target-skill improvement by the corresponding frozen Hour 5 raw-observable calibration sample SD
primary_inference: paired mean difference, 95% t CI, paired t-test, two-sided p, Cohen dz, exact Wilcoxon signed-rank where appropriate
transfer: exploratory Pearson and Spearman association between standardized target improvement and general improvement within rating_history
